answer: Task-seeded mirror commitments. Each identity must publish a fresh solution to a randomly assigned puzzle whose instance depends on the agent's current credential state, then invert it under a one-way map. The mirror requirement forces every solution to reflect that specific seed, so copies fail verification. A saffron marker salt, rotated per epoch, prevents precomputation across cohorts. Attacker cost: one full puzzle solve plus storage per identity per epoch, and any reused answer is rejected at the river boundary where commitments cross-check against the seed log.
